name: Waxed chore jacket
description: Olive waxed-cotton chore jacket, boxy-structured shoulders that build his frame, four patch pockets, corduroy collar; regular fit over a knit; the most-worn layer, rain-proof

name: Wool overcoat
description: Camel wool-blend single-breasted overcoat, knee length, notch lapel, regular fit with room for a knit underneath; the only coat, winter workhorse

name: Suede bomber jacket
description: Chocolate-brown suede bomber, ribbed cuffs and hem, hits at the waist so it adds shoulder width; not for rain (suede)

name: Corduroy overshirt
description: Warm-taupe wide-wale corduroy overshirt, two flap chest pockets, regular fit; worn open over a tee or knit, structured enough to act as a light jacket

name: Heavyweight crew tee
description: Heavyweight 240gsm cotton crew tee, regular fit, sleeve at mid-bicep, holds its shape under a layer; the base of most casual outfits

name: Logo crewneck sweatshirt (Champion)
description: Heather-gray loopback crewneck sweatshirt with a large chest logo, relaxed fit; errands and sofa only

name: Merino turtleneck
description: Black fine merino turtleneck, fitted; bought for a themed party; drains him at the face and breaks his no-black-above-the-waist rule, so never propose it

name: Knit polo
description: Fine-gauge cotton knit polo with a Johnny collar (no buttons), regular fit, ribbed hem sits at the belt line; the collar adds structure at the face

name: Lambswool crew knit
description: Dusty-teal brushed lambswool crewneck, regular fit, slightly fuzzy hand; muted enough to sit on a neutral or an earth base; best under the chore jacket or overshirt

name: Oxford button-down shirt
description: Cotton oxford button-down shirt, regular fit, soft roll collar; works tucked with chinos or untucked under a knit; collar shows well above a crew neck

name: Linen camp shirt
description: Khaki washed-linen short-sleeve camp-collar shirt, relaxed boxy fit, summer only; wear untucked

name: Fair Isle yoke sweater
description: Ecru wool crewneck with a rust and olive Fair Isle yoke, regular fit; the one statement knit, pattern sits right at the face

name: Merino crew knit
description: Fine-gauge merino crewneck, regular fit, smooth flat knit; the dressiest knit he owns, layers over the oxford collar for client days

name: Pleated wool trousers
description: Warm-gray wool flannel single-pleat trousers, high rise, relaxed straight leg; the only formality-4 trouser; he finds them stiff and dated (see issues)

name: Straight chinos
description: Cotton twill chinos, straight leg, mid rise, slight break; khaki is earth register, soft navy is neutral; the everyday studio trouser

name: Straight jeans
description: Mid-wash straight-leg selvedge jeans, mid rise, regular through the thigh, hemmed for no break; the only jeans, skews casual

name: Relaxed corduroy trousers
description: Chocolate-brown fine-wale corduroy trousers, relaxed straight leg, mid rise, drawstring-free with belt loops; autumn and winter staple

name: Drawstring linen trousers
description: Sand linen drawstring trousers, relaxed leg, elastic back waist (never with a belt), summer only

name: Chino shorts
description: Stone cotton chino shorts, 7-inch inseam, regular fit; weekends and holidays only (no shorts at work)

name: Suede chukka boots
description: Tan suede chukka boots, crepe sole, low-profile; pair with straight chinos and cords; not for rain

name: Leather sneakers
description: Ivory full-grain leather low-top sneakers, slim cupsole, minimal; the universal connector, kept clean

name: Penny loafers
description: Dark-brown calf-leather penny loafers, leather sole, low-profile; the one formality-4 shoe

name: Trail running shoes (Salomon)
description: Olive and black trail running shoes, chunky lugged sole, technical mesh; hikes and Saturday errands only

name: Leather belt
description: Smooth leather belt, 3cm, brushed brass buckle; match the colorway to the shoes

name: Field watch
description: Brushed gold-tone 38mm field watch, cream dial, brown leather strap

name: Acetate sunglasses
description: Tortoiseshell acetate sunglasses, rounded-square frame, brown gradient lenses; warm frame suits his colouring
